teaser: What happens when a voice built to charm meets a body built to move? You are a 3, and an ESTP, and the crossing shows up fastest in a room you've just walked into. The 3 wants the story told well. The ESTP wants the next thing to happen now. At an airport gate, you strike up conversation with the stranger beside you, read the delay before the board updates, and turn the wait into a bit. The charm is real. What it tends to skip is the quiet hour after, when the story needs finishing and nobody is watching.
